preconditions.description: Both strings P and T are non-empty and consist only of lowercase English letters.
The length of P is less than or equal to the length of T, as otherwise no occurrences of P in T can exist.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than or equal to 10^9 + 6, representing the answer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(T) - len(P) + 1 for i in [match.start() for match in re.finditer(re.escape(P), T)])
postconditions.description: All starting positions of occurrences of P in T are valid indices in T.

postconditions.expression: is_good_product := lambda positions: all(positions[i] % j == 0 for i in range(len(positions)) for j in range(1, 10)) if positions else False; sum_of_ways := sum(1 for k in range(1, len(positions) + 1) for subset in combinations(positions, k) if is_good_product(subset)) == int(stdout) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to select one or more occurrences of P in T such that the product of their starting positions is divisible by all numbers from 1 to 9 (i.e., a good number), modulo 10^9 + 7.
